title: Pure Wind-Up
summary: Pure Wind-Up build with generic staples and Number F0: Utopic Draco Future. Each Wind-Up monster can use its effect once while face-up on the field, so the deck swarms by resetting or replacing copies through Link, Xyz, and graveyard loops.

summary.title: Starters
points: Wind-Up Magician Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Wind-Up monster from the Deck in Defense Position whenever the effect of another Wind-Up monster is activated.
Wind-Up Shark Special Summons itself from the hand when a Wind-Up monster is Normal or Special Summoned, then raises or lowers its own Level by 1 to trigger Wind-Up Magician and Wind-Up Factory.
Wind-Up Rat switches itself from Attack to Defense Position to Special Summon a Wind-Up monster from the GY in Defense Position.
Wind-Up Factory searches any Level 4 or lower Wind-Up monster from the Deck once per turn whenever a Wind-Up monster's effect is activated.

summary.title: Opening: Wind-Up Magician + Wind-Up Shark
steps: Normal Summon Wind-Up Magician and Special Summon Wind-Up Shark from the hand, then activate Shark's Level-modulation effect to trigger Magician and Special Summon a second Wind-Up Magician from the Deck.

Use the first Magician and Shark to Link Summon Wind-Up Zenmaintenance, which searches another Wind-Up card (such as Wind-Up Rat or Wind-Up Factory) while the second Magician remains ready to trigger.

Activate Zenmaintenance's effect to banish a face-up Wind-Up and Special Summon a copy with the same name from the Deck, triggering the second Magician to summon another Level 3 or 4 Wind-Up for Rank 3, Rank 4, or Number F0: Utopic Draco Future.

summary.title: Once-While-Face-Up Reset
summary.text: Because Wind-Up monsters only restrict their effects to once while face-up on the field, flipping them face-down with Wind-Up Zenmaister or Legendary Wind-Up Key, banishing them until the next Standby Phase with Wind-Up Rabbit, or sending them to the GY as Link/Xyz material and reviving them with Wind-Up Rat or Zenmailfunction gives you a fresh activation.

summary.title: Control & Extra Deck
points: Wind-Up Zenmaintenance searches any Wind-Up card on Link Summon and banishes a face-up Wind-Up it points to in order to Special Summon a monster with the same name from the Deck.

Number F0: Utopic Draco Future, stacked onto Utopic Future made from two same-Rank Xyz Monsters, cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and negates a monster effect once per turn while taking control of that monster if it was on the field.

Wind-Up Zenmaines detaches a material to survive destruction and destroys a card on the field during the End Phase, while Wind-Up Arsenal Zenmaioh detaches a material to destroy two Set cards on the field.
Wind-Up Kitten bounces an opponent's monster to the hand, and Wind-Up Snail bounces a Set card.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Wind-Up Hunter and Wind-Up Carrier Zenmaity are both Forbidden in the TCG and excluded from this build.
